reviews.text: 主播主播，还有没有像新月纪元这样小时候抱过我的游戏？有的兄弟，有的，这样的游戏还有九个

几年前就看到了这游戏, 但总体上来说 目前 并不推荐这个游戏, 问题太多 1. 引导很弱. 游戏内虽然标了温泉房活动房, 但是玩家并不知道这是什么, 也不知道能干什么, 比如活动房有个不知道什么活动, 突然就满屏冒章鱼, 撞到还掉血, 完了给奖励也不知道给了啥, 主打一个一头雾水. 2. 信息模糊. 游戏内入侵房或者强行开门会给一个debuff, 但是这个debuff只在左上角有一个图标显示, 并没有其他手段查看当前有哪些debuff, 尤其在强行开门掉下去之后, debuff的描述根本来不及看. 如果说游戏就是打算不给实时查看局内状态, 让玩家记图标, 那请提供给玩家一个图鉴. 3. UI混乱. 突出的表现就在于诸如购买,领取之类的地方, 能买的按钮是黑色,不能买的也是黑色, 成就里的全部领取, 每局结束的返回, 都是黑色, 那我到底是点呢还是不点, 我是点了还是没点, 根本分不清. 还有购买家具没有提示, 不是看到材料少了都不知道自己买了, 关闭商店才会在左侧弹新获取道具. 4. 物品不明. 游戏内对于自己拥有的物品材料这些没有显示, 只有右上角显示了个月石和鱼, 好笑的是如果不是在角色界面点升级发现右上角少了我还不知道这玩意叫月石. 打造家具用的材料, 也是只能在购买物品的时候才知道该物品对应的材料有多少和缺多少. 5. 配音. 虽然点进去听声音就知道是谁, 一堆角色全是一个味更是让人难崩, 但这点不展开 6. bug. 就谈我目前碰到的一个bug吧, 在搭建家园的时候, 我是用的手柄操作, 但光标会自动锁定到我鼠标在的位置. 目前的游戏很难想象是一款打磨了五年的作品, 上面提到的问题都是属于在很前期就能发现但实实在在影响游戏体验的地方, 竟然这么久了还存在, 我不好说好吧. 游戏是好游戏, 在B站等平台也有一定的热度, 更希望作者能认认真真打磨游戏, 而不是在一声声"岳父"的称呼里迷失, 希望游戏越做越好.

Cute little roguelike with some pretty tight gameplay. Movement and combat (most of the time) feel great. Characters are generally well-balanced (though some definitely seem pretty bad on paper, would need to try them out more to be sure.). Weapons, skills, etc. are pretty standard for the genre but still good. I'd say this is an absolute steal for only $10 USD. A lot of minor issues in terms of polish, bugs, and balancing, but nothing that can't be chalked up to it being early access; if they really end up bothering you, just buy the game in a few years. The two major gripes I have with the game in its current state are the base building and visual clarity in later stages. Base building is just extremely barebones with basically none of the expected QOL features: you can't remove furniture en masse, you can't stack furniture on top of other furniture, you can't zoom out/in on the base itself when placing things, and so on. This wouldn't be an issue if you could just ignore the base building, but you can't because it's a fundamental progression system as well. The devs will probably fix this over time, though, so I doubt it's worth worrying about. As for visual clarity, once particle effects start stacking up things get messy. Melee isn't too bad, but guns and spells can potentially flood the screen with projectiles and make it a lot harder to actually see anything. This is particularly bad in certain boss fights that also spam projectiles; it kind of reminds me of Terraria's Calamity mod, for better or for worse. Again, totally fixable (and probably will be), but still notable. Other notes: - The game does have an English language option. There are a few missing translations in UI elements, but otherwise the game is entirely playable in English. - KB+M is probably usable, but controller is definitely the way to go. - Game runs perfectly through Proton. - Fishing minigame. - Beta is kinda goated.

Cute pixel art game with roguelike and base-building elements! The art for this is so pretty and cute. The characters are all so unique as well! It's a bit of a tough game at first but once you get the hang of it and do a few loops, you'll be beating the bosses in no time~ I really love the base-building side as the graphics are so cute. The furnitures can give you different bonuses as well. I do wish there were some more decorative things off the bat, like lighting and such so that my base isn't so dark :) Music is good, sound is good. Everything just feels so responsive. The game has that addicting "one more run" game loop that keeps you playing for longer than intended. I only have two hours in so far but I can see myself adding more onto that easily. The only issue I've run into is that my save isn't syncing to my steam deck, but it's not a huge deal!

Fun little game. Took me a moment to understand how some systems work but once you get in the groove, the movement feels smooth and responsive, the aesthetic is neat, the arts are cute and making builds is quite fun. I'm finding the game decently challenging but not to the extent it got annoying. There is some more work to do with the english translation. There are some parts that weren't translated yet but they were pretty rare. I did find through trial and error that weapons scaling is respectively STR, DEX and INT. Quite fun.

[h1]《新月纪元》：美少女游戏又迎来新花样[/h1] 最开始听说《新月纪元》这部作品，还是在一些诸如“怀胎五年终于临盆“的玩梗说法当中——毕竟这位制作人的B站粉丝数量可能要都倍杀销量了。从项目最初的idea开始，B站up主@王伟伦就开始一点一滴同步自己的开发历程，可以说粉丝们真正意义上见证了这款游戏的诞生，而今终于是进入一个看着孩子长大成人的「验收阶段」。发行伙伴选择了GG，这家在业内有口皆碑、扶持了无数国产作品的发行商再次证明了自己的犀利眼光，以及那份愿意陪游戏及开发组共同成长的耐心。总而言之，《新月纪元》虽然很难大红大紫，不过挣个温饱还是没问题，就像它的游戏质量一样：比上不足，比下有余。虽然加上时间成本会有些挫败，但假如大部分国产作品都能拿出本作的水准，那市场上将真会是一片欣欣向荣之景。 说说这款游戏的玩法吧。一旦带了「国产」「肉鸽」这几个标签，不跟缝合怪沾点边都说不过去，本作自然也不例外，但是缝不缝合私以为并不关键，重点还是看是否在玩法上进行了微创调整、让游戏变得足够好玩、给玩家带来更多游玩乐趣。从这个角度来看，我觉得《新月纪元》完成的还不错。你想要丝滑的手感这里可能没有，但也不至于太僵硬，尤其作者辛苦做了五年，美术跟音乐等制作维度都已经尽力拉满了——再加上一个美少女题材，外表上几乎已经立于不败之地。 不过针对BD以及细节平衡可能就没那么让玩家满意了，萝卜青菜各有所爱，《新月纪元》在数值上肯定不算上乘那一批。但它也有自己的堆料：只要学习的榜样足够多，你们就没法责怪我不够好玩了！所以你能在游玩过程中有各种既视感，能让你看到各路名家的身影，对于习惯了肉鸽的老登来讲利弊皆有，但确实能弥补国产技术力不足的问题、同时也能看到作者“虚心求教”的诚意。 除了基础的肉鸽玩法以外，游戏在局外养成上也下了点功夫，在已经机制拉满的情况下继续堆料，塑造了一个乐趣颇多的养成系统——该种地的种地，该暖暖的暖暖，该钓鱼的钓鱼，总有一款适合你的选择。总的来说，就如前文所言，它也许没有那么优秀，但也并不差，如果国产全部是这样的作品，又何愁产业不兴呢？ [quote] 执笔勾墨色，挥毫著文章；阳春布德泽，璞玉生光辉 欢迎关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44174077/]吟遊诗人的手札[/url]，书游戏特色，写游戏魅力 [/quote]

Lunavania is a steal for this price, even in Early Access. Feels like a mix of some roguelike and platformer games I've played before, executed well. Great artstyle and music, a lot of variety, flashy fun gameplay, and a ton of content even this early. I can only recommend this, especially to support the devs, but I have some notes to share about what could be improved: [list] [*]Visual Clarity: I feel like the game gets too hectic on later levels, unable to see anything and react to the action. [*]Unlocks: Having only one type of resource for item/ skill unlocks and metaprogression feels bad, and unnecessarily grindy. [*]Localization issues: There are still missing EN texts here and there. [*]Balance: The game feels unbalanced, some weapons are clearly much stronger than some others. [/list]

As you dive, you will encounter... The wilderness of the stages, the ruthlessness of the mobs, the unluckiness of the drops, and the madness of the bosses. As you surface, you will feel... The coziness of the base, the chillness of the beat, the calmness of the landscape, the cuteness of the characters, and the loveliness of the skins. As you venture, you will find... The wideness of the ground, the vastness of the buildings, the richness of the decorations, and the diverseness of the gears. All in all, this is a perfect game for a simple control but challenging gameplay. Can be played for short 5 mins and exit, or go straight 5 hours till you scream getting beaten again by the same boss. You could also use it for idle screen and do your chores that you have been procrastinating. (Based on real experience.) Furthermore, this game is still in development and the dev plan to add more features. WORTH EVERY PENNY! (Well yes, there are many games that are challenging and even more complex. But a simple but challenging game with CUTE pixel design? Ha, once in a project moon!)

种地问题，如何种地，怎样种地，用什么种地，在那里种，这些都没有教程，到底怎样种？还有合成公式，竟然没有任何提示，哪怕你给我一个合成图鉴也好，然而我还是找不到，到底在那里，全靠去外网去查看？还是自己手抄一份？摸索倒不要紧，可是你得给我一份目录啊，随即获得或者随不到那就是我自己人品问题，至少我是可以知道什么跟什么能组合一起，不用我特地留着到底用不用得着的？此开始，是2周目之后的评语：种地的问题，连一个花坛样的教程都不提一下，想破了头脑才突然想到老板店里面的那些“加成品”的，居然是种地用的。。。你牛！！！剧透一下：关于所谓的轮椅，枪械用电锯，法术用皇后，搭配寒冰和其他较为便利的武器和装备辅助即可，几乎能打爆很多关卡，其他的因为我可能是RP问题导致遇不到。。。 以下为大改之后的评价： 大改之后，玩着就变了另一个游戏了？以前的档案也没了，说好还我一个完美存档？还有键位也怎么变得我完全不认识，也不习惯，大改之前我还能用手柄玩，大改之后怎么改都不习惯，简直就是另外一个游戏一样，如果不是看到我大改之前获得的那些成就，真以为是新游戏。。。新添加的装备等一系列的东西，技能的，完全无法理解。。。忘记了还有一个没说的，我捡武器替换的时候，为啥总是会掉落自己的装备，每次都得重新捡回去。。。搞啥鬼啊。。。 忘记再补充一个：武器的组合方式。。。第一次找攻略看组合公式，合成出来了之后，商店那里应该要显示那公式出来啊，每次都记不住那公式。。。。

喜欢我回身泥头车，斐济悲三连发，拉稀加特林吗？卡头豌豆射手已经很恶心了，结果第四关的怪个个都是近战克星，你问我为什么不玩远程？十几发一个小怪我要清到什么时候 游戏流程基本就攒血攒血攒血，然后被恶心怪一波清空（从第四关开始，数值爆炸膨胀） 每次带回来的材料也只能提供微乎其微的强化，成长是只有一点点的，能推多远全靠运气（连轮椅都要后期才能解锁） 无尽的死亡轮回让玩家十分无力，喜欢从背板中享受技术的提升的人可疑尝试这款游戏 终于是打通第四层了，第五层拿到罪名后以为终于可以爽一把了，结果7颗心都交代在大蜈蚣上了，这蜈蚣到底有多少血？比四层boos都难打，打到后面不仅移速快，吃控短还一直发光速弹，又jb是近战克星 第六层的怪基本只能换血，没有双姬之发卡根本打不了，进房间先快速清理一个平台，然后扔召唤物苟着，还得躲着血滴子 真实游戏时长8.5h通关一周目，没摸到电锯还得更长时间

It's got good guts, but the "we already made enough money on our unfinished game, so eh, we'll just ditch it half-done and make a new dev name next time" is getting to be an extremely annoying practice.

This game has great graphics and actually really good gameplay loop for a roguelike. There is some base building and side quests at home just like the description. For an early access game, it was quite impressive and really showed potential. However, the 0.2 update just came out, and I feel it really set back my confidence in this game. First off, the developers forgot to mention that all save files in 0.1 were incompatible with the new patch. They have some cheat code for a complete save file, but that wasn't disclosed and I would like to see some transparency on this regarding future patches. Additionally, the controls have changed (for the worse). Now all weapons use mouse aiming, which also came at the side effect of controllers being completely unplayable because the aiming is fully locked on the mouse cursor. The devs have stated (late) that this needs an overhaul of the controls and is WIP. I get it's early access, but did they think pushing the change in controls in this state was a good idea? Additionally, a cooldown on dashes was introduced which in the long run I feel will be restrictive against players once bosses truly become bullet hell. It also makes some platforming impossible, notably the chase rooms where the goal is to quickly dash through obstacles - what was possible in 0.1 now results in the player likely taking multiple hits of damage that these rooms are best avoided. I really want this game to succeed at full launch, but right now the trajectory the devs took with this update bringing questionable design choices and not including notice of them in the patch notes does not bring confidence.

The system underwent significant changes between version 0.1 and 0.2. The unification of construction materials (changing from map resources to a single crystal) might be met with mixed opinions. The addition of the weapon and equipment attachment system should be fine once the translation is complete.(btw, translation is not complete even for Ver0.3.) [strike]However, I'm deeply disappointed that controller support has effectively been rendered unusable. The in-game cursor is now controlled by the right stick, which naturally limits sudden movements and makes the cursor easy to lose track of. Playing with a controller now feels like a significant disadvantage. (Though it should be noted that full controller compatibility has not yet been confirmed by the developers) [/strike] The controller issue was resolved in the 0.3. Furthermore, the biggest change is the shift from a room-clearing Roguelike to a survival-focused "Survivors like" game that forces players to endure set time limits in each room. No matter how much I upgrade, the game requires me to simply stand in a corner (where enemies don't gather) and hold the attack button while enduring an endless swarm of enemies and projectiles. Combined with the slight alteration in combat mechanics, I personally cannot find the fun in the current gameplay loop. --- add 0.3 --- The combat system underwent changes between version 0.2 and 0.3. The game now alternates between two types of progression. The first is a "Wave-based" system, similar to Version 0.1, where you must clear all enemies in a room three to four times. The second is a "Survivor-based" system, which requires you to either defeat a set number of enemies or survive until the time limit expires. While the Wave-based mode recaptures the same enjoyable feel of Version 0.1, the Survivor-based mode feels like an extension of the "poorly implemented endurance tests" seen in Version 0.2. The only viable strategy remains the same: you are forced to stay in a corner of the room and continuously unleash powerful attacks to survive. --- add 0.3 end--- Conversely, this might be a positive change for players who enjoy the game as a Survivors like title.

This game used to be really good before the most recent update. It basically changed everything. Before, it controlled like a Mega Man X game or like the Knight from Hollow Knight. Now it has mouse aiming, which for a controller player like me is pointless, so auto-aiming it is, which kind of takes away the skill and control the game used to have. The platforming rooms are gone too. All non-boss action segments seem to have been replaced with survival rooms where they just throw tons of mobs at you until the timer runs out. More often than not, I don’t even know what hit me because the screen gets so cluttered, and the most effective strategy is just stay in the corner and try not to engage as much as possible. I really preferred the old style, where you just cleared a room based on how many enemies there were. At least then your progress depended on how fast you could actually play, not just waiting for a timer. A lot of items don’t even have descriptions now either. Hopefully they roll back these core gameplay changes, because it’s honestly gotten pretty boring. It’s a shame, because I really had high hopes for this game. The art and premise are great, and I was eagerly waiting for the update earlier this year when I bought it. What a letdown.
